answer: Each new agent sits on a probationary ledge until it answers a paid compute challenge that a cheap scripted puppet cannot pass—seeded randomness forces a live model to reason through novel steps. The entry bond is slashed on failure, so mounting a thousand fake identities means fronting a thousand refundable-but-at-risk stakes plus real inference bills. Honest agents recover the fee through verified work, and a whisper of cross-attestation flags anyone who abandons the meadow of reputable peers.
